name: ReceiptBatch_ExpenseLocation
command:
-- Read-only AuraPlayer DB service for the Oracle EBS iExpense Location LOV.
-- Source lookup: oracle.apps.ap.oie.server.LocationsVO version LocationsVOImpl.java120.18.12020000.5
-- Observed context: EBS 12.2.14, org 204 Vision Operations, language code US (locale en_US).
-- No EBS session, MO context, or profile is initialized here.
-- Every lookup branch keeps the source status, active, end-date, and effective-date conditions.
--
-- Typed inputs below are AuraPlayer/JDBC binds and are intentionally unquoted.
-- Numeric-semantic inputs use VARCHAR transport plus TO_NUMBER because the
-- driver rejects blank NUMERIC parameters before the SQL guards run.
-- Defaults apply to NULL only. Oracle treats empty character strings as NULL,
-- so NVL defaults apply to empty character inputs as well.
-- Search simplification: source binds :8 through :12 used generated case variants.
-- They are replaced by one UPPER(location) LIKE UPPER(params.search_pattern) predicate.
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        TO_NUMBER(${P_ORG_ID:VARCHAR}) AS org_id,
        NVL(${P_LANGUAGE:VARCHAR}, 'US') AS language_code,
        TO_NUMBER(${P_EXPENSE_TYPE_ID:VARCHAR}) AS expense_type_id,
        ${P_EXPENSE_DATE:VARCHAR} AS canonical_expense_date,
        NVL(${P_ALL_SCHEDULES:VARCHAR}, 'N') AS all_schedules,
        NVL(${P_MERCHANT_LOCATIONS:VARCHAR}, 'N') AS merchant_locations,
        NVL(TO_NUMBER(${P_END_DATE_OFFSET:VARCHAR}), 0) AS end_date_offset,
        NVL(TRIM(${LocationName:VARCHAR}), '%') || '%' AS search_pattern
    FROM dual
)
SELECT
    q.location AS LOCATION_NAME,
    q.location_id AS LOCATION_ID,
    q.description AS DESCRIPTION,
    q.country AS COUNTRY
FROM (
    SELECT
        locations.location AS location,
        locations.location_id AS location_id,
        locations.description AS description,
        territories.territory_short_name AS country
    FROM APPS.AP_POL_LOCATIONS_V locations,
         APPS.FND_TERRITORIES_TL territories,
         params
    WHERE locations.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(locations.end_date + params.end_date_offset, sysdate))
      AND locations.territory_code = territories.territory_code
      AND locations.language = params.language_code
      AND territories.language = params.language_code
      AND (
            (
                ('Y' = params.all_schedules)
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT /*+ FIRST_ROWS(1) */ 1
                    FROM APPS.AP_EXPENSE_REPORTS_ALL expTemplates,
                         APPS.AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_PARAMS_ALL expTypes,
                         APPS.AP_POL_HEADERS schedules,
                         APPS.AP_POL_SCHEDULE_OPTIONS scheduleOptions
                    WHERE expTemplates.org_id = params.org_id
                      AND expTypes.org_id = params.org_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(expTypes.end_date, sysdate))
                      AND expTypes.expense_report_id = expTemplates.expense_report_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(expTemplates.inactive_date, sysdate))
                      AND expTemplates.web_enabled_flag = 'Y'
                      AND schedules.policy_id = expTypes.company_policy_id
                      AND schedules.category_code = expTypes.category_code
                      AND scheduleOptions.policy_id = schedules.policy_id
                      AND scheduleOptions.option_type = 'LOCATION'
                      AND scheduleOptions.status = 'ACTIVE'
                      AND scheduleOptions.location_id = locations.location_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(scheduleOptions.end_date, sysdate))
                      AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(NVL(schedules.start_date, sysdate))
                                             AND trunc(NVL(schedules.end_date, sysdate))
                )
            )
            OR (
                (params.expense_type_id IS NOT NULL)
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT /*+ FIRST_ROWS(1) */ 1
                    FROM APPS.AP_EXPENSE_REPORTS_ALL expTemplates,
                         APPS.AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_PARAMS_ALL expTypes,
                         APPS.AP_POL_HEADERS schedules,
                         APPS.AP_POL_SCHEDULE_OPTIONS scheduleOptions,
                         APPS.AP_POL_SCHEDULE_PERIODS periods,
                         APPS.AP_POL_LINES lines
                    WHERE expTypes.parameter_id = params.expense_type_id
                      AND expTemplates.org_id = params.org_id
                      AND expTypes.org_id = params.org_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(expTypes.end_date, sysdate))
                      AND expTypes.expense_report_id = expTemplates.expense_report_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(expTemplates.inactive_date, sysdate))
                      AND expTemplates.web_enabled_flag = 'Y'
                      AND schedules.policy_id = expTypes.company_policy_id
                      AND schedules.category_code = expTypes.category_code
                      AND scheduleOptions.option_type = 'LOCATION'
                      AND scheduleOptions.location_id = lines.location_id
                      AND scheduleOptions.status = 'ACTIVE'
                      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(scheduleOptions.end_date, sysdate))
                      AND scheduleOptions.policy_id = schedules.policy_id
                      AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(NVL(schedules.start_date, sysdate))
                                             AND trunc(NVL(schedules.end_date, sysdate))
                      AND periods.policy_id = schedules.policy_id
                      AND lines.schedule_period_id = periods.schedule_period_id
                      AND lines.location_id IS NOT NULL
                      AND lines.location_id = locations.location_id
                      AND trunc(NVL(APPS.FND_DATE.CANONICAL_TO_DATE(params.canonical_expense_date), sysdate))
                          BETWEEN trunc(NVL(lines.effective_start_date, periods.start_date))
                              AND trunc(NVL(lines.effective_end_date, NVL(periods.end_date, sysdate + 1)))
                )
            )
            OR (
                ('Y' = params.merchant_locations
                 AND locations.location_type IN ('CITY', 'COUNTRY'))
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM APPS.AP_WEB_VAT_SETUP_ALL vat_setup
                    WHERE vat_setup.enabled_code = 'Y'
                      AND vat_setup.org_id = params.org_id
                )
            )
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        locations.location AS location,
        locations.location_id AS location_id,
        locations.description AS description,
        '' AS country
    FROM APPS.AP_POL_LOCATIONS_V locations,
         params
    WHERE locations.undefined_location_flag = 'Y'
      AND locations.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND trunc(sysdate) <= trunc(NVL(locations.end_date + params.end_date_offset, sysdate))
      AND locations.language = params.language_code
) q,
params
WHERE params.org_id IS NOT NULL
  AND UPPER(q.location) LIKE UPPER(params.search_pattern)
ORDER BY q.location ASC,
         q.location_id ASC
